nodes.label: D-002 Schema created by app/db/schema.py, Alembic calls it
nodes.norm_label: d-002 schema created by app/db/schema.py, alembic calls it
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth and safe on a fresh DB; the cost is that subsequent schema changes must still be written as explicit migrations.

nodes.label: location_aliases table
nodes.rationale: Out-of-Java provinces/cities must exist so rejection is explicit, not 'unknown'.

nodes.label: D-003 Location aliases read from YAML; location_aliases table only seeded
nodes.norm_label: d-003 location aliases read from yaml; location_aliases table only seeded
nodes.rationale: Keeps the pipeline pure and testable without a DB; the normalizer must be changed if aliases later move to DB/API editing.

nodes.label: BR-06 Aturan Pembeda Duplikat vs Lowongan Serupa Berbeda
nodes.norm_label: br-06 aturan pembeda duplikat vs lowongan serupa berbeda

nodes.label: Kontrak Output Data Lowongan
nodes.rationale: Nama field stabil dan tidak boleh berubah tanpa menaikkan versi API agar integrasi n8n tidak rusak.

nodes.label: BR-07 Siklus Hidup Lowongan
nodes.rationale: Lowongan lama tidak dihapus otomatis; pembersihan data > 180 hari bersifat opsional.

nodes.label: n8n (workflow konsumen API)
nodes.rationale: Notifikasi tidak dibangun di dalam layanan; ditangani n8n, dengan opsi callback_url sebagai alternatif polling (retry 3× jeda 2/5/10 detik).

nodes.label: BlockedError
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator stops the platform (status blocked) and snapshots; it must not attempt to defeat CAPTCHA.

nodes.label: FastAPI app (api layer, routers + schemas)
nodes.rationale: Layered and unidirectional: api → services → (run manager / repositories); scrapers must not import the api layer.

nodes.label: RunManager (queue + asyncio worker)
nodes.rationale: Worker must be 1: only one writer to SQLite and an in-process queue.

nodes.label: BaseScraper (abstract scraper contract)
nodes.rationale: Pure parsers are separated from browser I/O so they can be tested with fixtures.

nodes.label: BrowserPool (shared Chromium + per-platform context)
nodes.rationale: One BrowserContext per platform per run for isolated cookies; resource blocking skipped when platform needs it.

nodes.label: keyword_rules table
nodes.rationale: Seed is idempotent: loader.py inserts only unseen (type, term, scope) rows and never overwrites source='user' rows.

nodes.label: DiscoveryPendingScraper
nodes.rationale: Scraper platform F3–F5 masih stub sampai discovery nyata dilakukan sesuai SCRAPER_SPEC.md §3.

nodes.label: Job Scraper API
nodes.rationale: Python + FastAPI tanpa frontend; satu container/satu worker uvicorn diwajibkan karena SQLite + antrean in-process; API dikonsumsi oleh n8n.

nodes.label: tests/fixtures/<platform>/
nodes.rationale: Parser scraper diuji dengan fixture HTML/JSON agar pytest berjalan offline tanpa jaringan.

nodes.label: job_run_links table
nodes.rationale: Retention: delete links for runs older than 90 days.

nodes.label: jobs table
nodes.rationale: duplicate_of_id always points to the KANONIK row (no chains); richer non-NULL values are never overwritten by poorer scrapes ('coalesce, prefer richer').

nodes.label: jobs_fts (FTS5 virtual table)
nodes.rationale: If FTS5 is unavailable at start, fall back to LIKE '%token%' and log a warning.

nodes.label: SQLite (data/jobs.db, WAL)
nodes.rationale: Single writer; SQLite and one worker limit scale, adequate for tens of thousands of rows and a single user.

nodes.label: Keputusan D2 (pemilik menerima risiko ToS)
nodes.rationale: Pemilik proyek secara sadar menerima risiko pelanggaran Terms of Service platform; mitigasi operasional (akun cadangan, batas volume, jeda panjang, hanya data publik lowongan) dipilih sebagai kompensasi, bukan penghapusan risiko.

nodes.label: Risiko dan Mitigasi (PRD §11)
nodes.rationale: Pemilik menerima risiko pelanggaran ToS (keputusan D2); gunakan akun LinkedIn khusus/cadangan dan jangan pernah mencoba menembus CAPTCHA — platform yang terkena tantangan dihentikan dan ditandai needs_attention.

nodes.label: Folder plan/ (task files untuk AI Agent)
nodes.norm_label: folder plan/ (task files untuk ai agent)

nodes.label: Kesopanan, Laju, dan Penanganan Blokir (§4)
nodes.rationale: Jeda berlaku antara setiap navigasi dan panggilan; jeda lebih panjang untuk platform berisiko; tidak ada upaya melewati tantangan dan tidak memakai plugin stealth.

nodes.label: SiteChangedError
nodes.rationale: Maps un-discovered platform scrapers to the degraded sub-run status instead of guessing selectors.

nodes.label: AuthRequiredError
nodes.rationale: Dipisahkan dari BlockedError untuk menandai kebutuhan login (mis. LinkedIn).

nodes.label: BlockedError
nodes.rationale: 403/CAPTCHA/challenge tidak di-retry; hentikan platform, simpan screenshot+HTML ke data/debug/, catat errors, lanjut ke platform berikutnya.

nodes.label: parse_detail_payload (pure parser)
nodes.rationale: Parser murni menerima str/dict/HTML dan tidak memakai browser agar dapat diuji dengan fixture tanpa jaringan.

nodes.label: parse_listing_payload (pure parser)
nodes.rationale: Parser murni menerima str/dict/HTML dan tidak memakai browser agar dapat diuji dengan fixture tanpa jaringan.

nodes.label: RawJob
nodes.rationale: description_text harus LENGKAP; nilai mentah disimpan agar normalisasi terpisah dari pengambilan data.

nodes.label: RawListing
nodes.rationale: posted_raw dipakai untuk pre-filter dan penghentian dini pada tahap listing sebelum detail diambil.

nodes.label: parse_salary(raw)
nodes.rationale: salary_raw selalu teks asli (dirapikan spasi) dan tidak diubah bentuknya; kolom numerik NULL bila tidak dapat diparse.

nodes.label: DeallsScraper
nodes.rationale: Detail pages are server-rendered so HTTP-first/JSON-LD parsing suffices; Playwright only needed to click 'Lihat Lebih Banyak'. Recruiter-activity labels must not be mistaken for posting dates.

nodes.label: GlintsScraper
nodes.rationale: Reported per-query result cap (~30) mitigated with full pagination, many search terms, and a dedicated remote search. updatedAt must not be used as posting date.

nodes.label: iter_listings
nodes.rationale: Must be idempotent and stoppable at any time (async generator that closes the page in `finally`); keyword encoded with urllib.parse.quote_plus to avoid dangerous queries.

nodes.label: JobStreetScraper
nodes.rationale: Internal JSON/GraphQL API interception preferred over DOM; internal listing date is ISO so presisi exact/date rather than falling back to relative labels.

nodes.label: KalibrrScraper
nodes.rationale: Many non-IT listings, so title pre-filter before detail requests to save requests.

nodes.label: KitaLulusScraper
nodes.rationale: Playwright used only for the 'load more' button; low IT volume expected and accepted.

nodes.label: LinkedInScraper
nodes.rationale: Login-based access chosen (owner decision D2) so results are complete; owner accepts the account-restriction/ban risk, so mandatory mitigations apply: concurrency 1, 4-9s delays, per-run/per-day caps, stop-all on challenge signals, read-only browsing, run last in scrape/all.

nodes.label: PintarnyaScraper
nodes.rationale: Insufficient research on the site, so full Discovery is mandatory first; if not publicly accessible a stub returning skipped with NOT_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE is not a failure and the overall run stays completed/partial.

nodes.label: scrapers/registry.py SCRAPERS mapping
nodes.rationale: Adding a platform = one class + one registry line + platforms.yaml entry + fixture + notes; no API/pipeline changes.

nodes.label: Pipeline Scraping Multi-Platform
nodes.rationale: Berhenti dini berdasarkan usia agar hemat waktu dan mengurangi risiko blokir.

nodes.label: Parser Tanggal (§5.1)
nodes.rationale: Teks seperti 'Rekruter aktif 8j lalu'/'Actively hiring' bukan tanggal posting dan hanya dipakai bila tidak ada sumber lain.

nodes.label: Dealls
nodes.rationale: HTTP-first HTML/JSON detail plus Playwright untuk tombol 'Lebih Banyak'; tanggal 'aktif' bukan tanggal posting.

nodes.label: Deskripsi Lengkap / FR-05 (§5.6)
nodes.rationale: Klik semua tombol perluasan dan tunggu panjang teks stabil sebelum ekstraksi; jangan memotong panjang; lowongan yang gagal total tidak disimpan hanya dengan cuplikan daftar.

nodes.label: Prosedur Discovery (§3)
nodes.rationale: Wajib sebelum menulis scraper tiap platform karena isi dokumen adalah hipotesis, bukan hasil pengujian langsung; output wajib docs/platform_notes/<platform>.md.

nodes.label: Deteksi tipe_kerja (§5.4)
nodes.rationale: Bila beberapa nilai muncul, ambil yang pertama dan simpan sisanya di extra.

nodes.label: Hierarki Strategi Ekstraksi (§2)
nodes.rationale: Coba dari atas ke bawah dan pilih yang paling stabil dan paling sedikit request: data terstruktur → intersepsi XHR → endpoint internal langsung → parsing DOM.

nodes.label: Glints
nodes.rationale: Metode hipotesis data tertanam (__NEXT_DATA__)/GraphQL internal dengan fallback DOM; kendala batas hasil per halaman dan rate limit.

nodes.label: JobStreet
nodes.rationale: Metode hipotesis JSON/GraphQL internal via intersepsi dengan fallback DOM; tingkat kesulitan sedang–tinggi karena anti-bot (403).

nodes.label: Kalibrr
nodes.rationale: Metode hipotesis API internal via intersepsi dengan fallback DOM; skema dapat berubah dan hasil terbatas per kota/kata kunci.

nodes.label: KitaLulus
nodes.rationale: HTML awal plus tombol load more via Playwright; volume lowongan IT rendah.

nodes.label: LinkedIn
nodes.rationale: Satu-satunya platform ber-login, risiko anti-bot/checkpoint/akun, sehingga dieksekusi TERAKHIR pada scrape/all agar kegagalan dan jeda panjangnya tidak menghambat platform lain; batas laju paling ketat.

nodes.label: Pintarnya
nodes.rationale: Struktur belum diketahui, mungkin app-first; metode ditentukan saat discovery.

nodes.label: docs/platform_notes/<platform>.md
nodes.rationale: Output wajib discovery dengan templat tetap, termasuk bagian 'Perbedaan dari SCRAPER_SPEC.md'.

nodes.label: Parser Gaji (§5.2)
nodes.rationale: Pemisah ribuan vs desimal dibedakan lewat pola; min > max ditukar; nilai tak terparse tetap menyimpan salary_raw.

nodes.label: tests/fixtures/<platform>/
nodes.rationale: Menyimpan ≥3 halaman daftar dan ≥5 halaman detail sebagai fixture (data pribadi dibersihkan) untuk menguji parser murni.

nodes.label: Deteksi sistem_kerja (§5.3)
nodes.rationale: Kata 'remote' biasa di deskripsi (mis. 'remote team','remote servers') tidak cukup; hanya frasa tegas yang dianggap sinyal.

nodes.label: Challenge detection
nodes.rationale: Random delays plus challenge detection guard against CAPTCHA/account-limiting responses such as checkpoint, authwall, 999/429.

nodes.label: Discovery phase
nodes.rationale: All early-research claims must be re-verified during Discovery because platform behaviour can change at any time; selectors must not be invented.

nodes.label: DATABASE — Job Scraper API
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for data schema, relevance scoring rules, location normalization, and deduplication algorithm.

nodes.label: ARCHITECTURE document
nodes.rationale: Precedence order is PRD > DATABASE > ARCHITECTURE > SCRAPER_SPEC, so deviations from ARCHITECTURE are recorded here.

nodes.label: SCRAPER_SPEC — Mekanisme Scraping per Platform
nodes.rationale: Struktur situs pihak ketiga berubah tanpa pemberitahuan, sehingga detail per platform hanya petunjuk/hipotesis yang harus diverifikasi saat discovery; aturan normalisasi, batas kesopanan, kontrak data, dan alur kode bersifat mengikat.

nodes.label: docs/platform_notes/linkedin.md
nodes.rationale: Risk summary (ToS, account restriction) must be written here and in the README.

nodes.label: D-001 HTML parser backend: selectolax lexbor
nodes.norm_label: d-001 html parser backend: selectolax lexbor
nodes.rationale: ARCHITECTURE §3 allows selectolax or bs4+lxml; selectolax.lexbor chosen because the `parser` backend is deprecated since selectolax 1.0, and it removes the lxml dependency.

nodes.label: D-004 `updated` counts only genuine detail re-fetches
nodes.norm_label: d-004 `updated` counts only genuine detail re-fetches
nodes.rationale: The known-listing path only touches last_seen_at, so a no-change second scrape reports new=0, updated=0 instead of updated=N.

nodes.label: D-007 F3+ platform scrapers are still discovery stubs
nodes.norm_label: d-007 f3+ platform scrapers are still discovery stubs
nodes.rationale: Deliberate: SCRAPER_SPEC forbids inventing selectors, so classes raise SiteChangedError (sub-run degraded) until real discovery is done.

nodes.label: D-009 EXPORT_MAX_ROWS env variable
nodes.rationale: Mentioned in ARCHITECTURE §7.2 but missing from .env.example, so added as an env with default 50000.

nodes.label: Keputusan D2 — LinkedIn Wajib Login
nodes.rationale: Menggunakan akun login agar hasil lengkap; pemilik menerima risiko pembatasan/pemblokiran akun dan wajib melakukan mitigasi.

nodes.label: parse_posted(raw, now)
nodes.rationale: Zona acuan Asia/Jakarta; presisi (exact/date/relative/unknown) dicatat karena teks relatif tidak dapat diperlakukan sebagai tanggal pasti.

nodes.label: Pipeline (normalize → filter → dedup)
nodes.rationale: Scrapers only extract; the pipeline decides — centralised normalization/filter/dedup logic is testable without a browser.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph workflow
nodes.rationale: Dirty graphify-out/ files are expected after hooks or incremental updates, so they are not a reason to skip graphify; skip only when the task concerns stale/incorrect graph output.

nodes.label: Pertanyaan Terbuka (PRD §14)
nodes.rationale: Tidak memblokir pekerjaan; agent memakai nilai default sampai pemilik mengoreksi.

nodes.label: D-005 Keyword seeding at startup only when the table is empty
nodes.community_name: D-005 Keyword seeding at startup only when the table is empty
nodes.norm_label: d-005 keyword seeding at startup only when the table is empty
nodes.rationale: seed_keywords is idempotent and never overwrites source='user', so a user-deleted seed is not forced back; POST /keywords/reseed gives an explicit reset.

nodes.label: D-006 Status endpoint accepts active|archived|expired
nodes.rationale: FR-47 only names archived; active cancels archiving and expired matches the DB enum, avoiding a new endpoint.

nodes.label: D-008 SSRF guard on callback_url
nodes.rationale: callback_url must be http/https; without CALLBACK_ALLOWED_HOSTS, private/loopback/link-local/reserved hosts (including DNS-resolved ones) are rejected, and with an allowlist only those hosts pass — the n8n host on the Docker network must be registered.

nodes.label: D-010 Internal scheduler not activated
nodes.rationale: SCHEDULE_CRON (FR-11, optional) is unimplemented because n8n is the primary scheduler.

nodes.label: Penyaringan Lowongan (rule-based)
nodes.rationale: Pemfilteran berbasis aturan (rule-based) agar deterministik dan murah; tidak ada penggunaan LLM untuk klasifikasi.

nodes.label: BR-01 Aturan Kata Kunci
nodes.rationale: Kata kunci IT, Web, Informatika sangat umum dan menghasilkan banyak lowongan tidak relevan (IT Support, Admin Web, Web Designer), karena itu dipakai kata kunci include/exclude dan tingkat kekuatan strong/weak.

nodes.label: BR-02/BR-03 Aturan Lokasi & Remote
nodes.rationale: Lokasi yang gagal diparse tetap diterima dengan penanda lokasi_terverifikasi=false agar tidak membuang lowongan potensial karena parsing gagal.

nodes.norm_label: deployment docker (satu container, satu worker uvicorn)
